subject.title: feat(chat): native session scroll-back with offset paging and import-aware history

question: May this PR ship while oversized CLI-import snapshots remain terminal until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/105644?
rationale: The branch deliberately improves regular native sessions without making byte-truncated imported history fully reachable, which affects persisted session-history behavior and requires maintainer intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Accept Scoped Limitation

options.title: Require Snapshot Paging
options.body: Hold this PR until oversized imported transcript history can be paged without repeated full materialization.
